create_pe_audio_encoder: create a PeAudioEncoder to encode audio input values into hidden state representations with positional embeddings
build_pe_audio_model: build a PeAudioModel that jointly encodes audio and text inputs for contrastive audio-text embedding
build_pe_audio_frame_level_model: build a PeAudioFrameLevelModel for frame-level audio-text alignment with per-frame audio embeddings

review_pe_audio_encoder_attention: review the PeAudioEncoderAttention multi-head attention module with rotary embeddings and KV-repeat support
